sense: at goal, in a ball game

terms.gloss: a throw, a shot (with the hand)
evidence: M-O s.v. throw, shot (Mercuriale 1569: omnem pilae jactum)
terms.comment: Any throw or cast, and the throw of dice (Cic. Div. 2.121). In ball games, a thrown shot (M-O; Traupman 46, a free throw jactus ā līneā). A kicked shot is ictus.

terms.gloss: a blow, a stroke; a kick at the ball
terms.comment: Classically a blow, a stroke or a sting; for a kick at goal, ictus with pede, as one says pilam pede īcere (see kick).

phrases.source: Erasm. Coll., Lūsus puerīlēs, Globī, I 41 (ūnus fōns)
